depth_model: pinned ViPE UniDepth2Model l; metric z-depth
estimator: exp(median of per-camera median log(depth / accepted-map camera z))); equal camera weights
selection_policy: evaluate frozen fitting scale; never refit or select another model
uncertainty_limitation: camera bootstrap measures cross-view repeatability, not common monocular metric bias; no measured ground-truth metric accuracy
threshold_rationale: Require 100 spatially distributed static points per training camera; reject broad local depth inconsistency or camera medians differing by more than 25 percent. Require global sampling uncertainty and reserved-frame disagreement at most 10 percent. These scale gates are independent of GeoCalib prior-trust and static-calibration gates. Frozen before depth inference; no result-dependent relaxation.
